boundary: This ledger records dated primary-source statements and their scope. It does not promote vendor targets, product status, shipment, yield, revenue, market share or production volume into current operational claims; those require a separate as-of confirmation and independent review.

entries.title: Supply Chain Risk Management glossary
entries.statement: NIST defines supply-chain risk management as identifying susceptibilities, vulnerabilities and threats throughout the chain and developing mitigation strategies. A visual network should therefore store evidence, tier, substitutability and mitigation rather than infer a chokepoint from node size alone.
entries.invalidation: The NIST definition is general and does not assign criticality to any semiconductor company or commercial relationship.
entries.caution: Direct source supports the stated definition or mechanism only; do not extend beyond its scope.

entries.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
entries.title: Measuring the Natural Rate of Interest
entries.statement: The New York Fed defines the natural rate of interest, r-star, as the real short-term interest rate expected to prevail when the economy is at full strength and inflation is stable. It is unobservable and must be estimated rather than read directly from a market price.
entries.invalidation: Do not treat a single model estimate, the SEP longer-run policy rate, or a TIPS yield as the true r-star; each has a different definition and uncertainty.
entries.caution: Direct source supports the stated definition or mechanism only; do not extend beyond its scope.

entries.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
entries.title: Measuring the Natural Rate of Interest: Past, Present, and Future
entries.statement: The LW/HLW approach treats r-star, trend growth and the output gap as latent states inferred from observable GDP, inflation and interest-rate data with a Kalman-filter framework. Real-time one-sided estimates and later two-sided smoothed estimates answer different questions and can be revised as data and the full sample change.
entries.scope: Latent-state estimation and real-time revision risk
entries.invalidation: Do not backfill a revised two-sided estimate into a historical policy decision or present a point estimate without its data vintage, model version and uncertainty range.
entries.caution: Direct source supports the stated definition or mechanism only; do not extend beyond its scope.

entries.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
entries.title: Are Financial Markets Good Predictors of R-Star?
entries.statement: New York Fed research compares model-based r-star estimates with market measures and warns that long-horizon real yields can contain time-varying risk and liquidity premia. Market-model disagreement is therefore evidence to investigate, not a mechanical replacement of one estimate by the other.
entries.invalidation: The research does not establish that one estimator will dominate in every sample or regime; preserve maturity, model, observation date, and confidence interval.
entries.caution: Direct source supports the stated definition or mechanism only; do not extend beyond its scope.

entries.title: How are Semiconductors Made?
entries.statement: SIA organizes semiconductor production into R&D, chip design, front-end fabrication and back-end assembly, test and packaging before integration into electronic products. This stage model is a stable teaching backbone; company relationships and chokepoints require separate evidence.
entries.invalidation: The high-level stages do not prove supplier criticality, market share, geography, capacity, qualification or substitutability for a particular product.
entries.caution: Direct source supports the stated definition or mechanism only; do not extend beyond its scope.

entries.title: 2026 Sandisk Investor Day presentation
entries.statement: At its August 2026 Investor Day, Sandisk described NBM contracts with weighted-average duration above four years and stated coverage targets of 50 percent of revenue in FY2027 and about two-thirds in FY2028. It also presented FY2028–FY2030 non-GAAP targets of mid-to-high-teens average revenue growth, about 80 percent gross margin, about 75 percent operating margin and about 50 percent adjusted free-cash-flow margin.
entries.scope: Dated company contract and financial targets
entries.invalidation: These are forward-looking company claims using non-GAAP measures and assumptions. Contract modifications, customer concentration, pricing floors, mix, taxes, working capital, capital intensity and reconciliations must be verified against future filings and results.
entries.caution: Company or research statement; do not treat as realized current operating fact without an independent as-of confirmation.

entries.title: EUV lithography systems
entries.statement: ASML describes EUV lithography as using 13.5 nm light, multilayer mirrors, and a high-vacuum optical path because EUV is absorbed by air and many materials; DUV remains part of the process mix.
entries.invalidation: A lithography system description does not establish a customer's yield, node equivalence, production volume, or supplier economics without separate filing or process evidence.
entries.caution: Direct source supports the stated definition or mechanism only; do not extend beyond its scope.

entries.title: Consumer Price Index concepts
entries.statement: BLS defines CPI as the average change over time in prices paid by urban consumers for a market basket; it is used in some official escalation and deflation contexts but is not every household's personal cost of living.
entries.invalidation: Population coverage, basket weights, substitution, quality adjustment, seasonality, and geography matter; do not treat a CPI movement as a universal household or asset-price measure.
entries.caution: Direct source supports the stated definition or mechanism only; do not extend beyond its scope.

entries.title: Cooling Water Efficiency Opportunities for Federal Data Centers
entries.statement: DOE defines PUE as total facility energy divided by IT-equipment energy. It is a facility-overhead metric, not a complete measure of compute productivity, cost, water use, carbon intensity, or business return.
entries.invalidation: Measurement boundary, period, load, and site-versus-source energy definitions must match before comparing PUE values.
entries.caution: Direct source supports the stated definition or mechanism only; do not extend beyond its scope.

entries.title: What Is Financial Stability?
entries.statement: The Federal Reserve describes a stable financial system as one that continues to provide financing through banks, lenders, and markets without becoming excessively vulnerable to shocks; leverage, liquidity, interconnectedness, and maturity transformation can amplify stress.
entries.scope: Credit creation, banking, liquidity, and financial-stability mechanisms
entries.invalidation: This is a mechanism and monitoring framework, not a diagnosis of current stability, a recession forecast, or evidence that every credit expansion is unsafe.
entries.caution: Direct source supports the stated definition or mechanism only; do not extend beyond its scope.

entries.title: Monetary Policy Report July 2026
entries.statement: The Federal Reserve's policy report separates policy-rate decisions, inflation, labour-market conditions, real interest rates, and capital investment; a policy signal is therefore an input to several transmission channels rather than a one-variable price forecast.
entries.scope: Official monetary-policy reporting and transmission framing
entries.invalidation: This source is a dated policy report, not a timeless causal estimate or a guarantee that a rate change will move every maturity, credit spread, asset, or economy in the same direction.
entries.caution: Company or research statement; do not treat as realized current operating fact without an independent as-of confirmation.

entries.title: Order Types
entries.statement: FINRA distinguishes market, limit, and stop orders by the trade-off between execution certainty, price control, and trigger behavior; volatile conditions can change the execution price or leave a limit order unfilled.
entries.invalidation: Broker routing, venue rules, order conditions, and market conditions vary; this is not a trading instruction or a guarantee of execution.
entries.caution: Direct source supports the stated definition or mechanism only; do not extend beyond its scope.

entries.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
entries.title: Inflation Expectations release
entries.statement: The FRED Inflation Expectations release provides separate series for expected inflation and real interest rates across maturities; the release is a data reference and does not make the measures interchangeable.
entries.invalidation: Series frequency, maturity, observation date, construction method, and revisions must be preserved; no current value is embedded in this article fact.
entries.caution: Direct source supports the stated definition or mechanism only; do not extend beyond its scope.

entries.title: What is Machine Learning?
entries.statement: Google's machine-learning reference distinguishes supervised learning by labeled targets, unsupervised learning by structure discovery in unlabeled data, reinforcement learning by rewards or penalties from actions, and generative systems by producing new content from learned patterns.
entries.scope: Learning paradigms and the difference between explicit rules and data-trained models
entries.invalidation: These are category-level definitions; a production system can combine paradigms, and a label such as generative AI does not establish quality, safety, or generalization.
entries.caution: Company or research statement; do not treat as realized current operating fact without an independent as-of confirmation.

entries.title: Tensor Processing Units and TPU architecture
entries.statement: Google Cloud documents TPUs as application-specific integrated circuits designed for machine-learning workloads, with matrix-multiply units, vector/scalar units, reduced-precision arithmetic, and on-chip high-bandwidth memory.
entries.scope: Domain-specific AI accelerators and matrix-oriented hardware
entries.invalidation: A TPU architecture is one accelerator design; its features cannot be generalized to all ASICs, NPUs, models, or production cost/performance without workload-specific evidence.
entries.caution: Direct source supports the stated definition or mechanism only; do not extend beyond its scope.

entries.title: What is a Semiconductor?
entries.statement: IBM's semiconductor overview explains that intentionally introducing dopant atoms changes silicon's electrical properties; n-type and p-type doping change the available charge carriers in different ways.
entries.scope: Silicon semiconductor material and doping mechanism
entries.invalidation: A material-level explanation does not establish a process recipe, device yield, node performance, or economics for a particular manufacturer.
entries.caution: Direct source supports the stated definition or mechanism only; do not extend beyond its scope.

entries.title: Securities products introduction
entries.statement: KRX distinguishes ETF, ETN, and ELW as listed securities products with different legal and economic structures; a listed product should not be treated as identical to the underlying asset or index.
entries.invalidation: Product terms, issuer credit, leverage, tracking, liquidity, fees, and applicable rules must be read from the current product documents; this is not a product recommendation.
entries.caution: Direct source supports the stated definition or mechanism only; do not extend beyond its scope.

entries.title: Integrating and Operating HBM2E Memory
entries.statement: Micron's HBM2E technical brief describes a wide-interface stacked-memory design whose bandwidth and capacity characteristics differ from conventional graphics memory; system-level bandwidth depends on the memory stack, interface, package, and workload.
entries.scope: High-bandwidth memory architecture and memory bottlenecks
entries.invalidation: The cited HBM2E document is product-generation specific; it does not establish current HBM availability, pricing, yield, or performance for later generations.
entries.caution: Direct source supports the stated definition or mechanism only; do not extend beyond its scope.

entries.title: DNN or k-NN: That is the Generalize vs. Memorize Question
entries.statement: Research on deep networks treats memorization and generalization as distinguishable behaviors that can coexist; fitting training examples alone is not evidence that a model will perform reliably on unseen data.
entries.scope: Model generalization, memorization, and evaluation boundary
entries.invalidation: The cited study is empirical and task-specific; it does not provide a universal test for all architectures, datasets, or deployment settings.
entries.caution: Direct source supports the stated definition or mechanism only; do not extend beyond its scope.

entries.title: AI RMF Core: Govern, Map, Measure, Manage
entries.statement: NIST AI RMF Core groups AI risk work into Govern, Map, Measure, and Manage. Governance is cross-cutting, while the other functions are applied throughout the AI lifecycle; the framework is voluntary and use-case agnostic.
entries.invalidation: Do not treat the framework as a legal requirement, a model-quality guarantee, or evidence that a particular system is safe.
entries.caution: Direct source supports the stated definition or mechanism only; do not extend beyond its scope.

entries.title: CUDA Programming Guide
entries.statement: NVIDIA's CUDA guide models heterogeneous systems with CPU host code and GPU device code, describes GPUs as highly parallel processors, and exposes matrix, tile, tensor-core, and multi-level memory operations as separate performance mechanisms.
entries.scope: CPU/GPU division of work, parallel matrix computation, precision, and memory hierarchy
entries.invalidation: CUDA is an NVIDIA programming and hardware model; it is not a universal description of every GPU, ASIC, NPU, workload, or measured performance result.
entries.caution: Direct source supports the stated definition or mechanism only; do not extend beyond its scope.

entries.title: OECD Productivity Statistics methodological note
entries.statement: OECD productivity measurement combines output with labour and capital inputs; growth can reflect more or better inputs as well as improved efficiency in how inputs are combined.
entries.invalidation: Productivity ratios depend on output definition, hours and capital-service measurement, price adjustments, capacity utilization, and measurement error; they are not a pure measure of worker effort.
entries.caution: Direct source supports the stated definition or mechanism only; do not extend beyond its scope.

entries.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
entries.statement: The RAG paper separates parametric memory stored in a pretrained sequence-to-sequence model from non-parametric memory retrieved from an external vector index, making provenance and knowledge updates a separate design problem from model parameters.
entries.scope: Parametric memory, external retrieval, and provenance
entries.invalidation: The paper's architecture and benchmarks do not guarantee factuality, freshness, or security for every retrieval system; index quality and retrieval behavior remain independent failure points.
entries.caution: Direct source supports the stated definition or mechanism only; do not extend beyond its scope.

entries.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
entries.statement: ReAct interleaves language-model reasoning traces with task actions so an agent can update a plan, handle exceptions, and query an external source or environment instead of relying only on internal generation.
entries.scope: Tool use and iterative agent control loop
entries.invalidation: The reported benchmark results are task- and implementation-specific; interleaving reasoning and actions is not a guarantee of correctness, safe side effects, or reliable planning.
entries.caution: Direct source supports the stated definition or mechanism only; do not extend beyond its scope.

entries.title: How to Read a 10-K
entries.statement: Investor.gov describes Form 10-K as containing the business description, risk factors, MD&A, and audited financial statements; the sections answer different questions and should be read together.
entries.invalidation: A 10-K is not a complete valuation, a forecast, or proof that management's narrative will occur; the filing date and reporting period must remain explicit.
entries.caution: Direct source supports the stated definition or mechanism only; do not extend beyond its scope.

entries.publisher: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission / Alphabet
entries.title: Alphabet 2025 Form 10-K filing
entries.statement: A filed 2025 Form 10-K example separates property-and-equipment capital expenditures in investing cash flow from depreciation recognized after assets are placed in service; capacity investment, accounting expense, and cash generation therefore need separate time and statement-line analysis.
entries.scope: CAPEX, depreciation, utilization, unit economics, and free-cash-flow interpretation
entries.invalidation: This is one issuer's filing example and not a universal accounting policy or current forecast; company disclosures, useful lives, capitalization policy, and reporting standards must be checked separately.
entries.caution: Direct source supports the stated definition or mechanism only; do not extend beyond its scope.

entries.title: SEC educational resources about income statements and balance sheets
entries.statement: SEC investor materials distinguish the balance sheet, income statement, cash-flow statement, and statement of shareholders' equity; each answers a different time or position question and should not be substituted for the others.
entries.invalidation: Definitions and presentation can depend on the reporting framework, filing, footnotes, and company-specific classification; do not infer current performance from a generic description.
entries.caution: Direct source supports the stated definition or mechanism only; do not extend beyond its scope.

entries.title: Attention Is All You Need
entries.statement: The Transformer paper proposed a sequence-transduction architecture based on attention rather than recurrence and convolutions, and emphasized greater parallelizability during training; this is an architecture result, not a claim that attention solves every reasoning or deployment problem.
entries.invalidation: The result depends on task, data, implementation, training setup, and evaluation; later systems add components and trade-offs beyond the original paper.
entries.caution: Direct source supports the stated definition or mechanism only; do not extend beyond its scope.

entries.title: 3DFabric advanced packaging
entries.statement: TSMC describes 3DFabric as a family of 3D silicon stacking and advanced-packaging technologies that integrates logic, memory, and other chiplets at the system level; packaging therefore affects bandwidth, latency, power, form factor, and cost rather than being only a final enclosure step.
entries.scope: Advanced packaging, heterogeneous integration, chiplets, and system bottlenecks
entries.invalidation: This is a vendor technology description; customer yield, capacity, pricing, supply availability, and product economics require independent filing and production evidence.
entries.caution: Direct source supports the stated definition or mechanism only; do not extend beyond its scope.

entries.title: World Models
entries.statement: World Models describes learning a compressed spatial and temporal representation of an environment and using it as input to a policy; this separates an estimated state-transition model from the policy that selects actions.
entries.scope: State, action, dynamics, planning, and model-based control
entries.invalidation: A learned world model can be incomplete or wrong outside its training distribution; simulated or imagined trajectories are not evidence that real-world control will transfer.
entries.caution: Direct source supports the stated definition or mechanism only; do not extend beyond its scope.

entries.title: Consumer Price Index — June 2026
entries.statement: BLS reported that the all-items CPI rose 3.5 percent over the twelve months ended June 2026 and the index excluding food and energy rose 2.6 percent. The divergence is a dated inflation-composition observation and is not itself long-run expected inflation.
entries.invalidation: Do not carry these values forward as current after a later release or substitute them for expectations, PCE inflation, or an inflation forecast.
entries.caution: Direct source supports the stated definition or mechanism only; do not extend beyond its scope.

entries.title: Summary of Economic Projections, June 2026
entries.statement: The June 2026 SEP reported a 3.1 percent median longer-run federal funds rate, while the June FOMC statement maintained a 3.50 to 3.75 percent target range. The midpoint-minus-longer-run comparison is a dated policy-stance reference, not a direct observation of r-star.
entries.invalidation: Recompute after a new FOMC target range or SEP, and do not ignore uncertainty, expected inflation, the balance sheet, fiscal conditions, or credit spreads.
entries.caution: Company or research statement; do not treat as realized current operating fact without an independent as-of confirmation.

entries.title: Sandisk announces sampling of BiCS10 1Tb TLC 3D NAND
entries.statement: Sandisk presents BiCS10 as a 3D NAND generation aimed at improving bit density, performance and power efficiency. For investment analysis, those vendor comparisons must be translated through yield, cost per bit, product mix, controller/firmware and customer qualification before they become margin evidence.
entries.invalidation: Sampling, internal comparisons and generation labels do not establish volume production, field reliability, customer acceptance, realized cost or realized margin.
entries.caution: Company or research statement; do not treat as realized current operating fact without an independent as-of confirmation.

entries.title: Sandisk and SK hynix collaborate on High Bandwidth Flash standardization
entries.statement: Sandisk and SK hynix announced collaboration on High Bandwidth Flash standardization for AI inference memory hierarchies. HBF should be treated as a technology option and adoption pathway, separate from current NAND revenue and from established HBM products.
entries.invalidation: A collaboration announcement or roadmap does not demonstrate an adopted standard, samples, qualification, production yield, customer deployment or unit economics.
entries.caution: Company or research statement; do not treat as realized current operating fact without an independent as-of confirmation.

entries.title: Best Practices Guide for Energy-Efficient Data Center Design
entries.statement: DOE guidance defines PUE as total annual facility energy divided by annual IT-equipment energy and recommends reading it with water, carbon and useful-work or utilization metrics. A lower PUE measures facility overhead, not model quality, accelerator utilization or token economics by itself.
entries.invalidation: Do not compare sites without matched measurement boundaries, climate, redundancy, workload, time window and IT utilization; a snapshot power ratio is not automatically annual PUE.
entries.caution: Direct source supports the stated definition or mechanism only; do not extend beyond its scope.

entries.title: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention
entries.statement: The PagedAttention paper models the KV cache as a major and dynamically sized memory component in LLM serving and applies virtual-memory-style paging to reduce fragmentation and improve sharing. It supports a causal link from context and concurrency to memory pressure, not a universal claim that the cache must reside on SSD.
entries.scope: KV-cache memory management in LLM serving
entries.invalidation: Reported throughput gains depend on models, hardware, workloads, runtime and baselines; later attention and cache-compression methods can change the bottleneck.
entries.caution: Direct source supports the stated definition or mechanism only; do not extend beyond its scope.

entries.title: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention
entries.statement: For a conventional transformer cache, capacity scales with active tokens, layers, KV heads, head dimension and bytes per stored element, with separate key and value tensors. Grouped or multi-query attention, quantization, eviction, sharing and recomputation change those factors, so context length alone is not a sufficient storage-demand model.
entries.invalidation: Treat the expression as an architecture-dependent capacity model, not a universal byte forecast or proof of SSD demand; validate the serving implementation and residency policy.
entries.caution: Direct source supports the stated definition or mechanism only; do not extend beyond its scope.

entries.title: Co-Packaging Framework Document
entries.statement: OIF's co-packaging framework addresses optical and electrical communication interfaces co-packaged with one or more ASICs and identifies application and interoperability considerations. CPO is therefore a system integration problem spanning ASIC I/O, optical engines, lasers, packaging, fiber and operations.
entries.invalidation: A framework document is not evidence of production volume, customer adoption, field reliability or the criticality of a named supplier.
entries.caution: Direct source supports the stated definition or mechanism only; do not extend beyond its scope.

entries.title: Co-Packaging Framework Document
entries.statement: OIF describes a system tradeoff between externally supplied and integrated lasers: external laser sources can improve serviceability and thermal separation, while added insertion loss raises required optical power; integrated sources reduce some loss but make thermal and repair paths different.
entries.invalidation: The framework does not select a universal winning architecture or prove a vendor's reliability, volume yield, link budget or field economics.
entries.caution: Direct source supports the stated definition or mechanism only; do not extend beyond its scope.

entries.title: Characterizing and Mitigating Bitline-to-Bitline Interference and Early Retention Loss in 3D NAND Flash Memory
entries.statement: Academic characterization of 3D NAND identifies early retention loss and process variation as mechanisms that can affect threshold-voltage behavior and error rates. Layer count and bit density therefore do not replace endurance, retention, ECC, firmware and qualification evidence.
entries.invalidation: The cited devices and generation are not current product benchmarks; do not transfer their measured values to a different vendor, node, cell type or controller.
entries.caution: Direct source supports the stated definition or mechanism only; do not extend beyond its scope.
